rows.value: Employers deduct PAYE from the remuneration of employees earning above the annual standard deduction, using the IRD's monthly, fortnightly and weekly tables (code 245, EC$25,000 standard deduction); remittances are due by the 15th of the following month and the annual return by 31 January.
